name: Britannia Chocolate Cake 100gm
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, EGG, VANASPATI, INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT, HUMECTANT (422), DEXTROSE, REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL, LIQUID GLUCOSE, COCOA SOLIDS (2.1%), HIGH MALTOSE SYRUP, FRUCTOOLIGOSACCHARIDES, COLOURS (150d, 150c, 102, 122, 132, 133), CAKE GEL [EMULSIFIERS (471, 477, 470(i)) & HUMECTANTS (1520, 422)), RAISING AGENTS (341(i), 500(ii), 450(vii) & 450(i)), NATURE IDENTICAL (CHOCOLATE) & ARTIFICIAL (CREAMY VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, INVERT SYRUP, IODIZED SALT, PRESERVATIVES (202 & 282), ACIDITY REGULATOR (330), BAKING POWDER, EMULSIFIER (475) AND STABILIZER (415). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT & EGG. STORE UNDER COOL, DRY AND HYGIENIC CONDITIONS AWAY FROM SUNLIGHT
